description: This file contains benchmark functions for different battery pack configurations, including SmallPack, MediumPack, LargePack, and Long variants. It sets up battery modules, runs simulations, and outputs results.

methods.name: run_LP_case_SmallPack
methods.description: Runs a simulation for a small battery pack configuration.

methods.name: run_LP_case_MediumPack
methods.description: Runs a simulation for a medium battery pack configuration.

methods.name: run_LP_case_LargePack
methods.description: Runs a simulation for a large battery pack configuration.

methods.name: run_LP_case_LargePackLong
methods.description: Runs a long-duration simulation for a large battery pack configuration with repeated charge/discharge cycles.
